description: Asks the free weekly edition for one email address. The address receives a single confirmation link and nothing else until its owner clicks it (double opt-in); one request per address per hour. Call it only for a person who asked to receive the editions, and say so with consent: true. The paid plan cannot be subscribed here: get_offers.premium.subscribe_url is where a person signs in and subscribes.

consent.description: true: the owner of this address asked for the editions

email.description: The address of the person who asked for the free weekly

name: subscribe_newsletter
title: Subscribe an address to the free weekly
